text:
maria: Starting thread — POC with MedSys. Streaming works locally but customer sees early 429s + stream cut when going through corp gateway.
raj: Can you paste client logs? Are they 429 from our API or gateway responses?
maria: Logs show gateway returning 429 and it strips Retry-After. Sample: `GET /v1/streams 429` then gateway responds with `X-Proxy-Error: rate_limited`
alex: Important detail: they use mutual TLS to the gateway, then gateway mTLS -> outbound. Could be header rewrite on the gateway.
sara (sales): Customer also asked if committed capacity would avoid this — pricing question: is dedicated capacity an option for this POC to rule out rate limits?
olivia: Yes for presales: we can spin a small Dedicated pool for 30 days. Need approval from product.
maria: Back to technical — their Node app uses fetch streaming with a 2s idle timeout on the proxy, so long prefix streaming gets cut. They see `ERR_SOCKET_TIMEOUT` after 5s even though tokens still flow.
raj: Possible fixes: 1) keep-alive and header `Connection: keep-alive`, 2) send periodic whitespace as heartbeat, 3) increase proxy idle timeout.
alex: Also noticed their proxy drops `Retry-After`. When our backend returns 429+Retry-After our SDKs rely on that header to back off. If proxy strips it we retry too fast and trigger more rate-limits.
maria: Sample TS client change we recommended to them:
```\n// TS: increase socket timeout & exponential backoff\nconst client = new Redwood({ timeout: 30000, retry: { retries: 5, factor: 2, maxRetryAfter: 60000 } });\nawait client.stream(...);\n```
raj: Python snippet for them too:
```\n# Python: set read timeout and respect Retry-After\nr = requests.post(url, stream=True, timeout=(5, 60))\n# custom retry: check response.headers.get('Retry-After') before requeue\n```
maria: Customer-side workaround (short term): switch to non-chunked polling (poll every 1s) until we can adjust proxy or route to Dedicated. They prefer streaming though.
sara (sales): If we offer Dedicated for POC, what's ETA? engineering?
eng-runtime-bot: Can provision a tiny Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 — ~4 hours once quota is approved. Need org and billing confirmation.
olivia: I'll file a quick request to product for POC Dedicated credit. cc @sara (sales).
alex: Also filing an eng-infra ticket to test header rewriting on corp gateways. If headers are stripped, we can add a fallback that encodes Retry-After into `X-Redwood-Retry` as a mitigation.
maria: One more odd log: gateway sometimes returns 524 (timeout) instead of passing our chunk finished events. That aligns with their proxy timing out on idle streams.
raj: Short term dev advice: SDKs should send a tiny keepalive frame every 10s for streaming connections when behind proxies that may have low idle timeouts. We'll add an opt-in `stream_heartbeat` flag.
sara (sales): Also need a short note for the security questionnaire: does our platform keep TLS mTLS termination on customer side for Private? They asked about key custody.
olivia: Answer: For Private deployment we support customer-managed mTLS and KMS integration. I'll add that to the reply doc.
maria: Action items: 1) olivia request Dedicated POC credits; 2) alex open infra ticket for header strip repro; 3) raj add stream_heartbeat flag + docs for TS/Python snippets; 4) olivia update sec questionnaire note.
alex: I'll attach a small repro script that demonstrates a proxy rewriting `Retry-After` and dropping keepalive frames.
sara (sales): Thanks — I'll tell the customer we have a plan: POC Dedicated option + SDK mitigations + security confirmation. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
maria: Will follow up with the repro and updated snippets.
olivia: Sending sec note now.
